authority.editableSourceOfTruth: Google Drive controlled registry and reference workspace
authority.githubRole: Versioned code/schema/audit snapshot and persisted reference binary mirror

routingPolicy.cannabisConfirmed: Only Cannabis/hemp-host evidence with appropriate scientific confirmation and item rights belongs in Cannabis-confirmed reference lanes.
routingPolicy.legacyHostInference: Some verified scientific candidates predate explicit host_context/host_species fields. Cannabis/hemp identity is inferred from the complete provenance record and is guarded by a CI assertion that forbids Cannabis/hemp records in the cross-crop lane.
routingPolicy.expertItemGated: Organism-only or expert images without Cannabis-host symptom ground truth stay item-gated and may support recognition/differentials only.
routingPolicy.crossCropTransfer: Non-Cannabis plant imagery is transfer evidence only and must never silently become Cannabis causal ground truth.
routingPolicy.training: All current persisted scientific reference binaries remain trainingEligible=false until panel/object review, source grouping, deduplication and leakage-safe split assignment are separately approved.
routingPolicy.virusViroid: HLVd/BCTV visual references remain molecularly bounded; persisted figures are reference evidence and never authorize definitive image-only etiologic diagnosis.

lanes.diagnosticCeiling: Molecular confirmation remains required for etiologic confirmation.
